cleanlootboxes.Label: Clean loot boxes
cleanlootboxes.CommandDescription: Cleans up Lootboxes.  Usage: !cleanlootboxes [dry|dryrun, all, orphans]/n dry/dryrun returns count only./nOrphans fixes lootboxes that have no viewer.

cleanviewers.Label: clean viwerers
cleanviewers.CommandDescription: Clean viewer database. Usage: !cleanviewers [dry|noplat|all]/nUse noplat to clear users with no platform ID/nThis is safe todo.

addtrait.Label: Add Trait
addtrait.CommandDescription: Adds a trait to your pawn.

settraits.Label: Set Traits
settraits.CommandDescription: Usage: !settraits [trait_name] [trait_name]. Add and replace traits in bulk.

factions.Label: Factions
factions.CommandDescription: Returns a list of the factions in current game.

colonists.Label: Colonists
colonists.CommandDescription: Returns the number of colonists, viewer pawns and animals.

storyteller.Label: Storyteller
storyteller.CommandDescription: Returns the name of the current storyteller and difficulty level.

shufflechildhood.Label: Shuffle Childhood
shufflechildhood.CommandDescription: Randomly selects a new childhood backstory.

shuffleadulthood.Label: Shuffle Childhood
shuffleadulthood.CommandDescription: Randomly selects a new adult backstory.

joinraid.Label: Join Raid
joinraid.CommandDescription: Joins a Twitch raid if one is active.

karmasettings.Label: karma explanation
karmasettings.CommandDescription: Shows your current Karma settings in chat.

giftcoins.Label: gift coins
giftcoins.CommandDescription: gift coins from one viewer to another viewer

buy.Label: buy
buy.CommandDescription: Purchase items or pawns from the store

pawn.Label: pawn
pawn.CommandDescription: Purchase a Pawn and join the Colony

equip.Label: equip
equip.CommandDescription: Equip an item to your pawn

backpack.Label: backpack
backpack.CommandDescription: Add item to your pawn's inventory

surgery.Label: surgery
surgery.CommandDescription: Purchases the implants specified and queues it for surgery on your pawn.

weather.Label: weather
weather.CommandDescription: Usage: !weather <type>. Types: rain, snow, fog, thunderstorm, clear, etc.

militaryaid.Label: militaryaid
militaryaid.CommandDescription: Call for military reinforcements from friendly factions

raid.Label: raid
raid.CommandDescription: Call a hostile raid on the colony

raidinfo.Label: raid info
raidinfo.CommandDescription: Show information about available raid types

help.Label: instructions
help.CommandDescription: Show how to use the mod

lookup.Label: lookup
lookup.CommandDescription: Search store items, game events, weather, or traits with prices. Use: !lookup [type] <name>. Types: item, event, weather, trait

modinfo.Label: mod info
modinfo.CommandDescription: Shows karma and coin earning rates

modsettings.Label: mod settings
modsettings.CommandDescription: Shows karma and coin earning rates

mypawn.Label: my pawn
mypawn.CommandDescription: Show information about your pawn. Social: relations, family/kin, friends/kith, rivals

revivepawn.Label: revive pawn
revivepawn.CommandDescription: Revives a pawn selected all or viewers

healpawn.Label: heal pawn
healpawn.CommandDescription: Heals pawn injuries - self, specific user, or all pawns with optional quantity

passion.Label: passion
passion.CommandDescription: Place a wager to have chance to increase a passion.

xenotypes.Label: xenotypes
xenotypes.CommandDescription: List all available xenotypes by race.  !xenotype [race]

queuestatus.Label: queue status
queuestatus.CommandDescription: Check your position in the pawn queue

chitchat.Label: chitchat
chitchat.CommandDescription: Have your pawn chat with another colonist (Cost: 10 coins)

deeptalk.Label: deep talk
deeptalk.CommandDescription: Have your pawn have a deep conversation (Cost: 15 coins)

insult.Label: insult
insult.CommandDescription: Insult another colonist (Cost: 5 coins, requires 5 karma)

reassure.Label: reassure
reassure.CommandDescription: Reassure another colonist (Requires Ideology DLC, Cost: 12 coins)

marry.Label: marriage proposal
marry.CommandDescription: Propose marriage to another colonist (Cost: 50 coins, requires 10 karma)

buildrapport.Label: build rapport
buildrapport.CommandDescription: Build rapport with another colonist (Cost: 25 coins)

convert.Label: convert ideology
convert.CommandDescription: Attempt to convert another colonist to your ideology (Requires Ideology DLC, Cost: 30 coins, requires 15 karma)

ricsaichatbot.Label: AI Chatbot
ricsaichatbot.CommandDescription: !!!DO NOT TURN THIS ON!!!Talk to the AI storyteller . Requires AIChatBotActive in settings.

rescueme.Label: rescue me
rescueme.CommandDescription: Request recovery of your vanished pawn. Captured/kidnapped creates a world rescue site; left-behind drop-pods home. Dead pawns use !revivepawn.

pawncheck.Label: pawn check
pawncheck.CommandDescription: Check another viewer's pawn for injuries only. Usage: !pawncheck <viewer>

botstate.Label: bot state
botstate.CommandDescription: AI bot only. Full colony gamestate snapshot as JSON (day, colonists, threat, food, medicine, weather, storyteller).

botpawns.Label: bot pawns
botpawns.CommandDescription: AI bot only. JSON list of free colonists (name, skills, health, mood, job).

botthreats.Label: bot threats
botthreats.CommandDescription: AI bot only. JSON live threat check: hostile faction members (not prisoners/slaves), manhunter animals, scaria animals (deduped). Use to see if a raid or pack is still active.

botmap.Label: bot map
botmap.CommandDescription: AI bot only. JSON map info (name, biome, temperature, weather, season).

botwealth.Label: bot wealth
botwealth.CommandDescription: AI bot only. JSON wealth breakdown (total, items, buildings, pawns) and threat points.

botresources.Label: bot resources
botresources.CommandDescription: AI bot only. JSON stockpile counts (meals, medicine, materials, components).

botgear.Label: bot gear
botgear.CommandDescription: AI bot only. JSON full loadout of the bot's assigned pawn (equipment, sidearms, all inventory, apparel). Not for viewers.

botfaction.Label: bot faction
botfaction.CommandDescription: AI bot only. JSON faction details (name, common race, relation, vanilla type, Ideology major memes if DLC). Usage: !botfaction [name]. Empty = list.
